mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals an inflationary environment with easing monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with easing monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
